01 · Proof · What Professional Distribution Looks Like

This is how a professionally distributed book looks

Search a properly published author and you see the same thing every time: the book with its own Google knowledge panel, a cover gallery, ratings, and the author recognised by name. That does not come from uploading a file to one website. It comes from being published, distributed and indexed across the ecosystem Google trusts. Marketing works far harder when this foundation is already in place.

The DP Kids by Thelma Daniels, with its own Google knowledge panel, cover gallery and author card
Sandra Schnakenburg, a full author panel with books, an award, a video interview and her official site
Sell Like Crazy by Sabri Suby, a book panel with audiobook summary, reviews and author profile
Five Days Till Dawn by Terry Cumberworth, a knowledge panel with retailers, genres and publication date

06 · Our Process · How The Six Months Run

From quiet launch to compounding momentum

You will never be left guessing. From day one you get a dedicated strategist, progress you can see inside Basecamp, and a review at the end of every phase. This is the order we work in, and why.

01

Discover and strategise

We learn your goals, study your book and its audience, and build the roadmap the next six months follow.

02

Build the foundation

Amazon listing, metadata, author profiles and press ready assets, positioned properly before we scale anything.

03

Launch across channels

Content, social, email and managed ads on Amazon and Meta, all running together rather than in isolation.

04

Amplify with PR and awards

Press releases, media features and award submissions that make you both credible and celebrated.

05

Grow and optimise

Transparent monthly reporting and constant optimisation, so budget follows whatever is already working.

06

Hand over and sustain

You finish with the assets, the accounts and the audience in your name, and a book that keeps selling after the program ends.

You keep one hundred percent ownership, royalties and creative control throughout. Our job is to make sure the work gets the attention it deserves.

07 · Partnership · How We Work With You

A strategic partner, not just a vendor

Six months of consistent, accountable marketing

Every campaign runs inside Basecamp with full transparency, so you see what is being created, where it is being placed, and how it is performing month after month. You get a dedicated team, monthly performance reviews, and a strategy that adapts to real results. Client references and live feedback are available any time you want to see how we work before we begin.
